preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cell, int) and 0 <= cell <= 1 for row in matrix for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix is an integer 0 or 1.
The number of rows R is between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns C is between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All rows have the same number of columns.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(row_number, int) and 0 <= row_number < len(matrix) for row_number in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a list of row numbers, each being a valid index in the matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[row_number] in [matrix[i] for i in range(len(matrix)) if i != row_number] for row_number in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row number in the return value corresponds to a row that is a duplicate of another row in the matrix.
The list of row numbers contains no duplicates.
